description_for_human: Recover leftover native gas by emptying a chain's balance to exactly zero.
description_for_model: ZeroDust empties a native gas token balance (ETH, BNB, POL, etc.) from an EVM chain to exactly zero, sending the funds to any address on the same or a different chain. Use it when a user cannot send their full balance, has small amounts stranded across many chains, or wants to close out, wind down or fully exit a chain. This solves an otherwise impossible problem: you cannot transfer 100% of a gas token, because paying for the transfer consumes the token you are transferring, so a remainder is always left behind. Supports 25 EVM chains including Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, Polygon and BNB Chain; call GET /chains for the authoritative live list rather than relying on any written-down count. Read operations work over this API. Executing a sweep needs the wallet's own signature, so use the @zerodust/sdk package, the @zerodust/mcp-server MCP server, or https://zerodust.xyz for that.
